summary: Round 2 re-check of the Evaluación Oftalmológica save fixes. Backend: 11/11 pytest passed (added a nested-null healing test for the new legacy record). Frontend: confirmed these fixes work: the legacy record with nested nulls loads with no crash; autosave reaches 'Guardado a las'; on 500 errors the status goes Reintentando 1/3, 2/3, 3/3, then 'Guardado offline' with the new toast.warning; 422 shows 'Sin guardar — revisa los datos ingresados' with a readable toast ('Campo inválido de prueba', not [object Object]); 403 shows 'Sin guardar — no tienes permiso para esta acción'; the idle state shows 'Sin cambios'; draft recovery after reload shows the dialog, sets 'Cambios sin guardar', sends a real POST, ends on 'Guardado a las' and clears the draft; a normal evaluation opened from Historial still loads all its data. Two issues remain: (1) CRITICAL data loss: a stale copy in the offline queue overwrites newer server data while the UI shows 'Guardado'; (2) the patient-header fix does not work (still '| 0 años | -').

ui_bugs.issue: The fix does not work. Opening the legacy record (empty paciente_nombre) via ?paciente_id or patient selection still shows ' | 0 años | -', and the search box is empty. RCA: stale closure. seleccionarPaciente() calls setFormData(prev => ({...patient data})) and then, in the SAME closure, awaits fetchEvaluaciones() and calls cargarEvaluacion(). Inside cargarEvaluacion, `pacienteActual` is read from the `formData` of the render that started the call, before the patient was selected, so it is always empty. Fix: pass the patient into cargarEvaluacion (e.g. cargarEvaluacion(evalHoy, false, paciente) from seleccionarPaciente), or use the functional updater setFormData(prev => ({..., paciente_nombre: evaluacion.paciente_nombre || prev.paciente_nombre, ...})) and set searchPaciente from the same source.

integration_issues.flow: Autosave 5xx -> offline queue -> later successful online save -> periodic syncPendingData (every 30s)
integration_issues.issue: CRITICAL DATA LOSS, reproduced. Steps: on an existing evaluation, PATCH /autoguardar returns 500 until retries run out ('Guardado offline', the queue holds motivo='... OLD'). The backend recovers, the user keeps typing (' NEW') and autosave succeeds ('Guardado a las'). About 30s later the interval-driven syncPendingData() PATCHes the OLD queued snapshot, and the server ends with motivo '... OLD', losing ' NEW'. The UI keeps showing 'Guardado a las HH:MM' and the newer text, so the doctor has no idea. Network log: [500 OLD x4, 200 'OLD NEW', 200 'OLD' (sync)]. RCA: a successful online autosave/manual save never removes or supersedes pending entries in localStorage 'novavision_evaluaciones_offline' for the same evaluation, and syncPendingData does not compare timestamps. The new retry->offline fallback makes this path common (any transient 5xx). The same applies to the 'create' path (it can POST a duplicate evaluation). Fix: after any confirmed online save of eval X (autosave + guardarEvaluacion), drop pending entries whose data.id === X (or whose timestamp <= the request start); for new evaluations, drop the paciente_id 'create' entry once the POST succeeds; optionally also skip stale entries in syncPendingData by comparing item.timestamp with lastSavedRef / server ultimo_autoguardado.

issues: After 'Recuperar borrador' the search input is empty and shrinks; the patient name box wraps onto 4 lines (the header gets squeezed). Cosmetic only.

action_items: CRITICAL: clear or supersede offline-queue entries (novavision_evaluaciones_offline) for an evaluation whenever an online save of that evaluation is confirmed, and/or make syncPendingData skip entries older than the last confirmed save. Otherwise stale data silently overwrites newer server data.
MEDIUM: fix the stale-closure bug in the cargarEvaluacion patient-header fallback (pass the patient explicitly or use the functional setFormData updater); also set searchPaciente from that value.
critical_code_review_comments: syncPendingData closes over pendingSync/evaluacionActual and is re-created every render; the 30s interval can sync entries the user has already superseded (root of the data-loss bug).
cargarEvaluacion reads formData from its closure, so it is stale whenever it is called after an await in the same handler (seleccionarPaciente).
